subject: Briefing lanes: presenter assignments & reading routes for Aurelia exec workshop
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julia Park <julia@aurelia.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Briefing lanes: presenter assignments & reading routes for Aurelia exec workshop

Team —

Thanks for the quick sync yesterday. Attached is a compact agenda (compact_agenda_v0.pdf) that consolidates the day into three blocks: Executive framing (40m), Use-case deep dives (90m split into 2x 40m slots), and Ops/Next steps (30m).

As we discussed, the ask for this thread is three things:
1) Confirm presenter owners for each slot (who will lead and who will support).
2) Confirm pre-read owners and scope (one-pager for execs + technical appendix).
3) Call out any travel constraints for presenters so we can lock rehearsal windows.

Quick notes:
- Target audience: Aurelia C-suite + product leadership (condensed, exec-level).
- We should include a 10–15 minute on-site demo (live) inside the Use-case 1 slot — if we do that we need a dedicated AV dry-run.
- I added a placeholder for seat assignments; Vanessa can take point on that and share a draft CSV.

Action we need from each of you by EOD Thursday (Sep 23):
- Kimberly: presenter owner & one-line bio for each slot.
- Lauren: recommend which materials belong in the exec one-pager vs technical appendix and volunteer a pre-read owner.
- Grace: coordinate rehearsal windows and AV needs.
- Vanessa: seed seatplan-draft.csv and confirm room capacity.

I'll consolidate and send an updated run-of-show by Friday.

Thanks —
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Program Manager, Field Events
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mateo — high level thumbs-up on the block layout. Quick owner notes:

- Executive framing (40m): Kimberly will lead; Ravi Khatri (APAC solutions lead) will do the 10m framing demo. I attached a short one-pager to pull speaker copy from (speaker-one-pager-Ravi.docx).
- Use-case 1 (40m): Product deep dive — Lauren to co-own the content; I will introduce.
- Use-case 2 (40m): Ops & security — Grace to lead with Lauren supporting.
- Ops/Next steps (30m): Vanessa + myself to surface commitments and timelines.

On the live demo: Ravi travels in on the 27th morning PST and is available for a dry-run either 27th afternoon or 28th morning. If the AV team needs 30–45m, please block that.

Pre-reads: I suggest a 1-pager for execs (one slide, key outcomes + ask) and a 4–6 page technical appendix for eng/ops folks. I can draft the exec one-pager if Lauren confirms the top three outcomes.

Kimberly

Great — a couple of clarifying items from my side:

1) Pre-read split recommendation:
- Exec one-pager (owner: Kimberly) — outcomes, ask, 3 KPIs, 1-slide decision table.
- Technical appendix (owner: Lauren) — architecture diagram, data flow, security controls, and a short appendix listing expected SLA numbers.

2) Rehearsals: I recommend two short on-site rehearsals: full run-through (60m) the afternoon before, and a 30m tech-check 90 minutes before the session start. That limits surprises and gives execs a late check-in window.

3) Materials handoff: I'll place a pre-read_toc.md into the drive folder with proposed filenames and a target owner column. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3C_aurelia-workshop (owners column populated).

Travel constraints: I fly in on 27th red-eye and will be available for late-afternoon rehearsal on the 27th.

LA
Lauren Bishop
Head of Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the clarity — a couple requests from Aurelia side:

- Can we get an ultra-condensed 1-page exec brief (single A4, two bullets per slide) that the CEO can scan in under 3 minutes? If Kimberly can lead that, great.
- Seat plan: we prefer clustered seating by function (C-suite + product at front; ops and eng behind). Vanessa — can you propose two variants?
- On the demo: technically we prefer a recorded fallback in case live connectivity is unstable. Would you all be able to prepare a 3-minute recorded clip as backup?

Also: does Redwood have an NDA addendum for on-site recordings? If so, please share.

Team —

Solid progress. Consolidated next steps and owners below; I'll publish a single run-of-show (final) on Friday morning.

Confirmed owners:
- Exec one-pager (owner: Kimberly) — exec-friendly 1-pager, deliverable: PDF & slide (by Thu EOD).
- Technical appendix (owner: Lauren) — 4–6 pages, includes architecture diagram + SLA table (by Thu EOD).
- Use-case 1 demo backup (owner: Grace) — 3-minute recorded clip + connectivity checklist.
- Seat plan variants (owner: Vanessa) — two options in seatplan-draft.csv (by Wed noon).
- AV dry-run & rehearsal windows (owner: Grace) — full run-through on Sep 27 15:00–16:00, tech-check Sep 28 08:30–09:00 (please confirm if these times conflict).

Notes & asks:
- Kimberly: can you attach your exec one-pager draft to the drive link and mark it "exec-draft-v1"?
- Vanessa: please share the seatplan CSV in the drive folder and set the Sheet permissions to Aurelia programs.
- Lauren: add a short table in the appendix called "decision asks" that maps each session to a concrete ask (approve pilot, allocate staging tokens, sign-off on SLA).

Julia — on the NDA for recordings, I'll route a short addendum to you today (DocuSign link in related_links). If the recording addendum is acceptable we will confirm the demo fallback approach.

Attachments in this thread: compact_agenda_v0.pdf, pre-read_toc.md, speaker-one-pager-Ravi.docx, seatplan-draft.csv

Thanks everyone — moving to action.
